tickets.subject: Cannot log in - password reset not arriving
tickets.body: I tried to reset my password but the reset email never arrives. I'm locked out of my account and can't access the portal.
tickets.resolution: Reset emails were landing in spam due to a DKIM misconfiguration. Whitelisted the no-reply sender and asked user to check spam. Password reset link is valid for 30 minutes - resend if expired.

tickets.subject: VPN keeps disconnecting every few minutes
tickets.body: The VPN connection drops every 3-4 minutes and I have to reconnect constantly. It's slowing down my work.
tickets.resolution: Caused by idle-timeout on the VPN gateway plus an outdated client. Updated the VPN client to the latest build and increased the idle timeout to 30 minutes. Stable since.

tickets.subject: Invoice shows wrong amount for March subscription
tickets.body: The March invoice charged us for 12 seats but we only have 9 active users. Please correct the billing.
tickets.resolution: Three deactivated seats were still counted due to a delayed sync. Reconciled the seat count, issued a credit note for the 3 extra seats, and enabled real-time seat sync.

tickets.subject: Password reset link says expired
tickets.body: I requested a password reset but when I click the link it says the link has expired. Cannot log in.
tickets.resolution: Reset links expire after 30 minutes. Advised user to request a fresh link and complete the reset immediately. Confirmed access restored.

tickets.subject: Application crashes when exporting large report
tickets.body: Every time I try to export a report with more than 5000 rows the application crashes with a 500 error.
tickets.resolution: Export ran synchronously and hit a memory limit. Moved large exports to a background job with pagination; exports over 5000 rows now stream to a downloadable file.
